output.summary: Outside Riverside, ticket time has been flat at about 17.6 minutes since the October 2024 Made Here redesign. The board knowingly accepted that rise in exchange for the made-to-order positioning and a 19-minute ceiling. Satisfaction, check size, sales and margin all improved, and speed-of-service scores did not change. The 12-minute benchmark panel excludes scratch kitchens, so it is not comparable. Riverside's spike traces to the unfilled saute/pasta vacancy. Group operations deferred the GM's transfer requests, and no other location shows a similar problem. The reason Delgado left is disputed. Best actions are to restore Riverside's staffing and to reset the benchmark. Par-cooked standardization, the 12-minute bonus target and replacing the GM are harmful.
